description: This file defines the 'SiloUnavailableException' class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime to signify that a request was canceled due to target silo unavailability. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and inherits from 'OrleansMessageRejectionException'.

classes.name: SiloUnavailableException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception indicating that a silo is unavailable, inheriting from OrleansMessageRejectionException and equipped with multiple constructors for different use cases. Marked as serializable.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a fixed message indicating silo unavailability.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(string msg)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and inner exception for exception chaining.

methods.name: SiloUnavailableException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Obsolete constructor used for deserialization purposes. It calls the base deserialization constructor.
